title: Forming Kestrel Corp. and its state taxes
instructions: Kim and Jay form Kestrel Corp. on March 1, 2025. Answer the formation and state tax questions.

exhibits.title: Formation
exhibits.content:
- Kim transfers equipment (basis **$80,000**; FMV **$150,000**) for stock worth **$130,000** and **$20,000** cash.
- Jay transfers land (basis **$200,000**; FMV **$170,000**) for stock worth **$170,000**.
- Kim and Jay own 100% of Kestrel immediately after. No election is made under §362(e)(2)(C).

exhibits.title: State Y (double-weighted sales formula)
exhibits.content:
| Factor | State Y | Everywhere |
|---|---:|---:|
| Sales | 3,000,000 | 10,000,000 |
| Property | 1,000,000 | 5,000,000 |
| Payroll | 400,000 | 4,000,000 |

Kestrel's 2025 apportionable business income is **$2,000,000**.

rows.label: Kim's recognized gain
rows.explanation: Lesser of boot (20,000) or realized gain (70,000) = **20,000**.

rows.label: Kestrel's basis in the land
rows.explanation: Net built-in loss property takes FMV under §362(e)(2): **170,000**.

rows.label: Jay's stock basis
rows.explanation: Without the election, Jay keeps carryover basis in his stock; the corporation's asset basis is reduced.
